howToUse.comparison: Numbers: |actual - expected| <= tolerance (p-values: absolute + relative). Members are matched by memberId; reasons are compared as sets; all other fields exactly.
howToUse.coreLevel: Every case runs through the statistics core on the counts given in data (both runners unless runners says otherwise).
howToUse.rowExpansion: For endToEnd cases, expand each group in order into rows (label, prediction, group): tp -> (1,1), fp -> (0,1), fn -> (1,0), tn -> (0,0); selection-only groups: selected -> (1,1), others -> (0,0). Multiclass: matrix[i][j] rows with label labels[i] and prediction labels[j]. Regression: target 0 and prediction = error. Calibration bins: label 1 for positives, score = meanScore, prediction 1 when score >= 0.5. Positive label '1'.
